title: Current qualification truth: dev10 wait repair, clean live HID generation pending
summary: dev9 remains the Current Library semantic/FIDO baseline. Static review found that its live qualifier sampled HID and hidraw only once after new-device discovery, so asynchronous Linux publication could cause a false failure. dev10 fixes that evidence race and passes both generation and delayed-binding shell regressions; clean presenter-owned target HID/hidraw qualification is still pending.
invariants: The dev9 package-side suite passed dependency, core, Chapter 9, profile, configuration-state, HID profile, CTAPHID, CTAP2 GetInfo, credential, Raw Gadget presentation-error and Raw Gadget control-direction tests.
The target Raw Gadget substrate was proven on kernel 7.2.8-1-default with raw_gadget, dummy_hcd, /dev/raw-gadget and dummy_udc.0.
The earlier dev8 USB node CAFE:F1D0 is not accepted as evidence about the dev8 presenter because that presenter later failed Raw Gadget RUN/UDC registration with EBUSY.
dev9 correctly added idle-UDC ownership and sysfs-path:devnum generation identity but sampled HID interface and hidraw publication only once.
dev10 waits independently for HID class 03 and matching hidraw while requiring presenter liveness.
The delayed-binding regression fails against unmodified dev9 behavior and passes against dev10; the stale-generation guard also passes.
A clean dev10 live PASS still requires presenter-owned new CAFE:F1D0, HID class 03 and matching hidraw.
libfido2 discovery, browser/WebAuthn enrollment and relying-party acceptance remain later qualification stages.
procedure: Do not reinterpret the invalid dev8 no-HID result as a provider defect.
Run the clean dev10 live qualifier on an idle UDC.
On timeout, inspect persisted Raw Gadget trace and kernel diagnostics before modifying provider semantics.
Only after HID/hidraw PASS, add libfido2 and browser/WebAuthn evidence as separate gates.

provenance.claim: Validation records package-side passes, Raw Gadget substrate, invalidated dev8 observation, dev9 generation guard and pending clean live acceptance.
dev10 records the delayed binding race, bounded waits, regression result and still-pending clean target acceptance.
